Open source & Digital Public Good

Open, transparent and sustainable

OpenBQ is licensed under Apache 2.0 and is transitioning to become a Digital Public Good: free to use, open to inspect, built to last.

Free access, rigorous standards

The Apache 2.0 licence ensures accessibility and encourages global collaboration while maintaining rigorous technical and ethical standards.

Optional services

Impact

Built for impact and scale.

By embedding standards‑based quality measurement, near real‑time feedback, and continuous quality monitoring, organisations can noticeably reduce enrolment re‑tries, improve system performance, and maintain interoperable, trustworthy identity ecosystems.

Legacy data review

Evaluate existing biometrics to support targeted re-enrolment strategies rather than costly full-system re-capture.

Enrolment quality

Quality monitoring to detect systemic issues (e.g., sensor drift, environmental degradation) and provide operator feedback.

New architectures

Validate quality approaches as new ID systems and equipment become available.
